economic_note: Stronger growth normally supports currency strength through better real activity and tighter policy expectations.
Higher inflation can support a currency when it increases expected policy tightening, but can become negative if it damages real growth.
Higher unemployment is generally currency-negative because it signals labor-market weakness and easier policy pressure.
